title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：AI龙头回调40%，为何仍不急于加仓？
speaker: Adam Gold

segments.en: You mentioned you've been holders of a video for some time now. Have you changed your allocation or your exposure to the stock since the fallout around Jensen Wang?
segments.zh: 你提到你们持有某视频公司已有一段时间。在Jensen Wang相关事件后，你们是否调整了配置或敞口？

segments.en: Yeah, we're very long term holders and believers in AI in 2016.
segments.zh: 是的，我们是长期持有者，自2016年起就相信AI。

segments.en: When I met Jensen at a conference, did I ask them about the potential of AI?
segments.zh: 当我在会议上遇到Jensen时，我问了他们关于AI的潜力。

segments.en: And the semiconductor, the machines that are going to process this intelligence.
segments.zh: 以及半导体，那些将处理这种智能的机器。

segments.en: We made the analogy. I talked to him about Intel on the PC side or IBM on the super computing side.
segments.zh: 我们做了类比。我和他谈了PC时代的英特尔或超级计算时代的IBM。

segments.en: And we thought, but actually AI would have bigger potential than all of that.
segments.zh: 我们认为，实际上AI的潜力会比所有这些都大。

segments.en: And so the company that would leave that revolution might be the biggest company in the world.
segments.zh: 因此，引领这场革命的公司可能成为世界上最大的公司。

segments.en: This has been in 2016 when it was a $40 billion market cap.
segments.zh: 这是在2016年，当时市值400亿美元。

segments.en: And at the time it was doing about a billion dollars quarter in total revenue, $4 billion for the whole company.
segments.zh: 当时它每季度总收入约10亿美元，全公司40亿美元。

segments.en: It's currently $430 billion revenue run rate.
segments.zh: 目前营收运行率是4300亿美元。

segments.en: So the numbers are incredible. It's actually some no one's ever seen a company of this size grow at this pace.
segments.zh: 所以这些数字令人难以置信。实际上，没有人见过如此规模的公司以这样的速度增长。

segments.en: So now it's trading at mid single digit PE multiple.
segments.zh: 所以现在它的市盈率只有中个位数。

segments.en: You know, so it's come down 40% from its high.
segments.zh: 你知道，所以它已经从高点下跌了40%。

segments.en: And you think about the growth rate of 70, 100% plus revenue growth they just had.
segments.zh: 你想想他们刚刚实现的70%、100%以上的营收增长率。

segments.en: The CFO now in terms CEO has guided to at least 75% next year.
segments.zh: 首席财务官现在以首席执行官的身份指引明年至少增长75%。

segments.en: This is just remarkable growth. And I think until we have answers now to your question, over time since 2016, we've reduced our position by about 75% in total.
segments.zh: 这是非常显著的增长。我认为，在回答你的问题之前，自2016年以来，我们已经总共减少了约75%的仓位。

segments.en: It still has grown to become our largest position in size just because of the compounding.
segments.zh: 由于复利效应，它仍然成长为我们的最大持仓。

segments.en: But we would like to buy more of it in time.
We just have to wait for some of these questions to get answered. I think the congressional and Senate testimony in a few weeks will be important.
segments.zh: 我们只需等待其中一些问题得到解答。我认为几周后的国会和参议院听证会将会很重要。
